items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: they had, off and on, they'd have Bechet.

ctx.x: I want to ask you how your husband got started, uh, playing drums.

Well, he started, uh, he told me he used to take two sticks, you know, drumsticks. And his mother had one of them wooden bits. And that's how he started beating drums on the back of the bed. And he used to say, I know, put them sticks down. His mother would get after him by putting the sticks down. And that's how he started playing drums. Beating on the back of his mother's bed. And then after that, well, when he started out with the drums, then he got the drums. That's when he was working with Parker Davis, when…
Yeah. But didn't Byron make these first games with the Zuzu?
